text:
Maya Chen: FYI — discovered misposted USD amounts on EUR invoices generated during the early-morning FX cache blip. This will affect revenue schedules and deferrals for May close. Can we triage quickly? :alarm_clock:

Thomas Li: what's the scope? sample ids and which job ran?

Maya Chen: samples: INV-2026-0450, INV-2026-0456. The billing export shows fx_rate used = 1.1209 but authoritative market snapshot should have been ~1.0862. That changes USD amounts and hence deferred splits.

BillingBot: alert: fx_cache_stale detected at 2026-05-01T02:10Z; provider=Xignite; cached_timestamp=2026-04-30T23:59Z; affected_pairs=[EURUSD]; records_affected=121

Anya Patel: did the month-end recognition run use that cache or was it a separate GL posting step?

Thomas Li: recognition run revrun-20260501-09 pulled fx snapshot at job start. If snapshot had stale timestamp due to provider issue, all EUR invoices during 02:00-03:30 UTC likely impacted.

Zach Rivera: quick check SQL: ```sql
SELECT invoice_id, invoice_date, currency, line_amount_local, fx_rate_recorded, usd_amount_posted
FROM billing.invoice_lines
WHERE currency='EUR' AND invoice_date >= '2026-05-01' AND fx_source='xignite_cache';
```

Emma Park: we should prevent posting adjustments until we have controller approval. If we have to reverse/republish schedules, need a clear audit trail for auditors.

Maya Chen: small sample I pulled: INV-2026-0450: 12000 EUR, fx_used=1.1209 -> usd_posted=13450.80; correct_fx=1.0862 -> usd_correct=13034.40; delta = -416.40 USD. That pushes deferred revenue down.

Anya Patel: negative delta means recognized USD should be lower; adjust deferred revenue accordingly. We'll need reversal journals for the posted recognition and then re-post with corrected amounts.

Thomas Li: engineering: provider returned a 200 with an older timestamp, so cache TTL logic didn't replace it. Opened INF-741. I'll add a guard to treat payload timestamps older than the previous fetch as invalid so job will retry.

Zach Rivera: proposed ops runbook: 1) enumerate affected invoices and produce CSV 2) place AR holds on those invoices pending adjustment 3) run recognition job in dry-run with corrected snapshot to generate proposed journal diffs 4) submit journal packet for controller approval 5) post approved adjustments and release holds 6) include in month-end close memo

Maya Chen: I'll run the enumeration and attach CSV to the ticket. ETA 25m.

Emma Park: CSV please include invoice_id, customer, invoice_date, original_fx, corrected_fx, posted_usd, corrected_usd, delta_usd, deferral_bucket_before, deferral_bucket_after, recommended_journal_lines. We'll need GL account mapping for each suggested entry.

Anya Patel: add an 'audit_flag' column if the invoice is part of any pending audit/ARR review so we prioritize escalation.

BillingBot: report generated: affected_count=121; high_impact_count=7 (abs(delta) > 2000); report_link=https://redwood.internal/reports/fx_cache_impact/1767010001.csv

Maya Chen: uploaded CSV and highlighted top 15 high-impact rows. Example: INV-2026-0450,Customer:BrightMetrics,12000,1.1209,1.0862,13450.80,13034.40,-416.40,Deferred-ST,Deferred-ST,rev_rec_reverse;rev_rec_repost

Thomas Li: I'll pause scheduled recognition runs and add a temporary feature flag to require explicit operator confirmation for any re-run touching >100 invoices.

Emma Park: I'll prepare a draft approval packet for controller with the CSV, proposed journals, INF-741, and engineering notes. Controller approval required before posting.

Zach Rivera: ran dry-run on staging for the corrected snapshot; generated journal diff file and verified totals match CSV. No writes. I'll attach the staging diff to the ticket in 15m.

Anya Patel: we must document the rationale in the month-end close memo and include the exact tickets, timestamps, and FX provider response. Auditors will need to see chronology.

Maya Chen: agreed. I'll create the memo and link everything: CSV, INF-741, revrun id revrun-20260501-09, staging-diff link.

Emma Park: once controller signs off, Finance Ops should coordinate weekend window for posting adjustments to avoid interfering with automated billing processes.

Thomas Li: ETA for fixes and guard deploy: ~1.5 hours. Will post update here when done.

Maya Chen: thanks everyone. tagging @controller and @legal for visibility in case of customer-impacting changes. :white_check_mark:
